claims.verbatim:
Steamship Manhattan, Deaken, Vera Cruz July 9, via Si-
sal 11th, and Havana 14th, with mdse and passengers, to C
A Whitney. July 17, lat 28 46, lon 77 44, saw bark Telegraph,
bound N; 16th, lat 32 34, lon 77 24, brig Amanda Guion,
bound N; same date, lat 33 43, lon 76 18, passed an Am bark
with house on deck just forward of mizzenmast. Had fine,
pleasant weather the whole voyage. [cut]

Steamship Manhattan, Dearken[?], Vera Cruz July 9, via Sisal the 11th,
and Havana the 14th, with mdse. and pass. to Charles A. Whitney.
July 15, in lat. 28 46, long. 77 44, saw American bark Telegraph, bound
N; 16th inst., in lat. 32 34, long. 77 24, saw American brig Amanda
Guion, bound N; 16th inst., in lat. 33 43, long. 76[?] 18, passed an Am.
bark, with house on deck, just forward the mizzenmast. The M. had
fine weather the entire passage.
